answer: Locks are recorded in wharf, expire in pearl, and nadir lists each expiry. An farming party running 71 aliases therefore needs 65 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1307 identities would post 2612 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
